page: Vultr voc-s-24c-192gb-3840s-amd is an x86_64 architecture server within the Optimized Cloud Compute family. It features 24 dedicated vCPUs powered by an AMD EPYC processor running at 2.0 GHz, configured with 12 physical cores and 2 threads per core. The hardware configuration includes 192.0 GB of system memory, providing 8.0 GB of RAM per core. Local storage is provided by a bundled 3840 GB NVMe SSD, and the instance includes one complimentary public IPv4 address.

In benchmark evaluations, the server demonstrates strong multi-core and single-core CPU performance, placing in the top 25% for stress-ng and Geekbench multi-core tests. Memory bandwidth for large, potentially uncached blocks is highly efficient, ranking in the top 10% for both read-only and write operations. Other workloads, such as Redis SET operations, static web serving throughput, and small-to-medium model LLM inference, perform within the average range.

With its high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 1:8 and substantial local NVMe storage, this server offers a resource-dense profile suitable for memory-intensive and storage-heavy applications. It is well-suited for hosting databases, executing data processing pipelines, and running memory-bound enterprise applications. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent performance without resource contention, making it a reliable choice for production environments requiring stable compute and high memory capacity.
